summary: Bangkok, the capital of Thailand, is a big city with many people, many cars and a lot of traffic, because everybody has a car
The writer says the CO2 from cars destroys the ozone layer and makes the weather on Earth hot
The writer suggests people go to work or travel together, for example sharing one car with a co-worker
The writer says this is faster, avoids traffic jams, prevents being late and helps save the Earth, and hopes traffic will decrease
arguments: Everybody having a car increases the amount of traffic in Bangkok
CO2 from cars destroys the ozone layer and makes the Earth hot (as the writer claims)
Travelling together in one car is faster, avoids traffic jams and means people are not late for work or school
Sharing cars is good for saving the Earth and has benefits for everybody in the city
arguments_main: Names travelling together (sharing one car) as the most important argument
Gives a reason from the text, e.g. it is the writer's proposed solution with benefits for everybody
